reason: I'd throw the free 30 receipts at it to see how it reads them, but my shop doesn't have that many receipts a month, and paying $19 every month for something a friend and I could wire up with n8n and ChatGPT in a weekend doesn't make sense on my money.
objection: It's a new little bot. If it disappears in six months I'm the one rebuilding everything, so why not build my own from the start and own it.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper small plan, around $7-9 a month for my volume, plus some proof it will still be running next year, like a lot of Bali businesses already using it or a promise that the sheet keeps working if the bot shuts down.
